description.ja: 自分好みの輝きを創り出す、12灯式LEDユニット登場！
description.en: Introducing a 12-light LED unit that allows you to create your own glow!

description.ja: • LEDユニット対応のBANDAI SPIRITSプラモデルに。白色①LED6灯、白色②LED6灯の組み合わせで、12灯を同時に発光できる。
description.en: • BANDAI SPIRITS plastic model compatible with LED unit. By combining 6 white ① LED lights and 6 white ② LED lights, 12 lights can be emitted at the same time.

description.ja: • ユニット側面のスイッチで対応するLEDのON/OFFを制御。2種類の白色LEDの組み合わせでバリエーションも楽しめます。
description.en: • Control the ON/OFF of the corresponding LED with the switch on the side of the unit. You can enjoy variations by combining two types of white LEDs.
